findings.title: Vector element name without marshal prefix panics via unchecked type assertion
findings.claim: A vector whose element type name lacks the org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal. prefix resolves to a type with no element type; goType does an unchecked type assertion and panics inside info.Zero(), before the PR's new nil check, and nothing recovers it on the Scan path.

findings.title: vectorElemMinSize re-walks nesting at every level, costly for deeply nested types
findings.claim: vectorElemMinSize recomputes the remaining nesting repeatedly, giving roughly 5e8 operations for a hostile type nested ~1400 deep versus ~1e6 on base; computing variable-length and minimum size in one pass would fix it.

findings.title: Zero-dimension inner vector minimum size wrongly counted as 1 byte instead of 0
findings.claim: vector<float,0> takes 0 bytes per element but is counted as 1, so vector<vector<float,0>,N> with an empty payload that decoded on base now errors, contradicting the PR's claim that the check never rejects valid data; reachable from the wire since frame.go:861 accepts dimension 0.

findings.title: Comment overstates that every path becomes an allocation and that unmarshalList behaves…
findings.claim: The comment claiming every path below turns into an allocation is false for the array path, and the claim that unmarshalList does the same overstates it since unmarshalList uses a constant /4 bound on slices only.

findings.title: Stale nil/empty comment and duplicated Dimensions>0 && data!=nil guard
findings.claim: The comment about nil/empty falling through no longer matches the code, and the Dimensions > 0 && data != nil guard now appears twice in a row.

findings.title: Float/double length-mismatch errors now unreachable except for overlong payloads,…
findings.claim: The "expected N bytes, got M" errors now fire only for payloads that are too long, but the code doesn't say so; only the PR body explains it.

findings.title: Nested-vector error message omits inner type and dimension
findings.claim: The error prints custom(org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.VectorType) without the inner type or dimension; the commit message implies the error names the server-sent type, which is true only for unknown element types.

findings.title: PR body's claim that every new test fails against pristine code is false
findings.claim: Several new tests (TestUnmarshalVectorAcceptsWellFormedPayloads, TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType, two "still decodes" subtests) pass on base, and TestVectorElemMinSize doesn't fail on base — it doesn't even compile there.

findings.title: Commit 0276a66 justifies bound with a floor its own tests call a bug
findings.claim: The commit justifies the size bound with a one-byte-per-element floor, then replaces that floor with the recursive minimum, while its own tests call the one-byte floor the bug.

findings.title: Commits lack Refs trailers despite PR body citing issue #1091 and DRIVER-954
findings.claim: Neither commit has a Refs: trailer even though the PR body cites issue #1091 and DRIVER-954; 17 of the 40 prior commits use such trailers.

findings.title: Test locks in surplus-trailing-byte behaviour slated to change under a different issue
findings.claim: The "payload with a trailing byte" test calls a 13-byte vector<int,3> well-formed, locking in surplus-bytes behaviour the PR defers to #1086, which will require the test to change when #1086 lands.

findings.title: No test covers an empty non-NULL payload with dimensions > 0
findings.claim: The headline behaviour change has no direct test: no case covers an empty non-NULL payload ([]byte{}) with dimensions greater than 0.

findings.title: No test reaches the MaxInt32 saturation branch
findings.claim: No test reaches the MaxInt32 saturation branch at marshal.go:1135-1137.

findings.title: makeVectorType duplicates makeFloat32VectorType and makeDoubleVectorType
findings.claim: makeVectorType duplicates the logic already present in makeFloat32VectorType and makeDoubleVectorType.

findings.title: Tests pair TypeText with UTF8Type though the parser maps that to TypeVarchar
findings.claim: Tests pair TypeText with UTF8Type, but the parser actually maps UTF8Type to TypeVarchar.

findings.title: Pre-existing: type name dropped on malformed metadata unlike new unknown-type handling
findings.claim: helpers.go:222 and :267 still drop the type name on malformed metadata, unlike the PR's new behaviour for unknown types.

findings.title: Keeping the custom name on unknown types is not a user-visible break
findings.claim: Keeping the custom name on unknown types is not a user-visible break because only the vector-parsing paths call it, and nothing compares type values.

findings.title: The allocation test is not likely to flake
findings.claim: The allocation test is not likely to flake.

findings.title: Nil SubType does not crash on any input base handled safely
findings.claim: A nil SubType doesn't crash on any input that base handled safely; head crashes on fewer inputs than base.

findings.title: vectorElemMinSize assumes no type is both fixed-size and variable-length
findings.claim: vectorElemMinSize assumes no type is both fixed-size and variable-length; this only matters if a vector element can ever be empty, which could not be established.
